name: The Man Being The Head Of The House
overview: Scripture teaches that the man holds the position of head over the household, reflecting the order established since the fall where the husband is to rule over his wife as indicated in Genesis 3:16. Ephesians 5 further clarifies this role by instructing wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, while husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for it. This headship is not authoritarian but Christ-like, emphasizing loving leadership and care. The appointment of elders in Titus 1:5 underscores the importance of orderly leadership within the church and by extension, the home.
